## How to obtain

Catch it with a [Fishing Rod](Item-fishing-rod.md). See [Fishing](Fishing.md) for water requirements and bite timing.

## Using it

Eat directly, cook into Cooked Fish, or combine with two vegetables for Fish Stew in either Cooker.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
